source.name: League of Legends Wiki — TFT:Encounter, Set 18 "Active Encounters" table
crossCheckedWith: https://hexkey.app/database/encounters (Set 18 odds table — same 20 encounters, later-patch odds)
notes: Riot's Data Dragon bundle does not publish encounters as items or units, so this file is hand-maintained from the wiki instead of being generated by scripts/build-set18-data.mjs.
The Set 18 table lists exactly 20 encounters at 5.0% each; three independent sources agree on the names, the effects and the champion pairings.
Chinese names and descriptions are translations of the English source text. Riot does not publish an official zh-CN encounter string table.
championId resolves to the id of the same champion in champions.json. It is omitted where the wiki lists no champion for the encounter.
Yunara has no championId: she is not part of the Set 18 18.3 champion snapshot in champions.json.
"No Encounter" is a real outcome and therefore a real option: picking it records "this game genuinely had no encounter", which is different from leaving the field empty (never recorded).
Do not add encounters that are not in the Set 18 table. Set 16 / Set 17 encounters (Carousel of Chaos, Market Offering, ...) belong to those sets and are deliberately absent.
